methodology: Exercise the explicit shared:: invalidation rule (R-SRC-002) and the single-engine rule (R-SRC-001) directly via evidence_reuse.evaluate_rule; confirm planner scope-safety via C42.28/C42.30 test suites (43 passed). No redesign of dependency inference performed in this phase.

rule_proofs.requirement: explicit shared:: changes invalidate the intended dependent scope
rule_proofs.mechanism: R-SRC-002 fires when change.target.startswith('shared::') and component in target.split('::')
rule_proofs.evidence: Change('shared::common_calculations::credit_card_engine') -> R-SRC-002.triggered=True for credit_card_engine; False for loan_engine (unnamed) and reconciliation_engine (unrelated).

rule_proofs.mechanism: R-SRC-001 fires only when change.target == component
rule_proofs.evidence: Change('credit_card_engine') -> R-SRC-001.triggered=True for credit_card_engine; False for loan_engine.

rule_proofs.requirement: shared-infrastructure ambiguity does not silently cause under-testing
rule_proofs.mechanism: A shared-module FILE change without the explicit shared:: prefix maps only to its own component via describe_change; dependents are NOT auto-invalidated
rule_proofs.evidence: Change('common_calculations') -> R-SRC-002.triggered=False for credit_card_engine. Without explicit shared:: prefix, dependent engines keep reusable (stale) evidence. This is the documented HIGH-severity gap (C42.33/C42.37).

rule_proofs.requirement: the planner does not silently expand to repository-wide verification
rule_proofs.mechanism: EvidenceAwarePlanner.plan selects only components whose reuse disposition is invalidated; all others excluded with explicit cause
rule_proofs.evidence: C42.28 scenario B (single_engine_change): 1 selected, 13 excluded. C42.30 TestVerdicts: planner deterministic, selects exactly the affected component. 43/43 C42.28+C42.30 tests pass.

sufficiency_for_final_certification.rationale: When a shared change is correctly declared with the shared:: prefix naming the affected dependents, R-SRC-002 invalidates exactly those dependents and the planner re-measures only them; the planner never expands to a repository-wide run. Ordinary single-engine changes are correctly bounded.
sufficiency_for_final_certification.limitation: The mechanism is EXPLICIT, not automatic. A shared-module file change that omits the shared:: prefix will not propagate invalidation to dependents, creating an under-testing risk if the changer fails to declare it. This is the established C42.33/C42.37 gap.
sufficiency_for_final_certification.classification: CERTIFIED_WITH_LIMITATION (explicit mechanism sufficient; auto-detection deferred as post-certification enhancement)
sufficiency_for_final_certification.reason_not_blocker: The system reliably answers the nine canonical questions for explicitly-declared changes. Auto-detection of shared dependencies from file paths is a deliberately deferred optimization (constraint: do not redesign dependency inference in M38.6). The documented practice requires shared:: prefix for shared-infrastructure changes; this is a known operational boundary, not an architectural defect.
